artworks.title: Eleazer Tyng
artworks.description: A pale-skinned, clean-shaven man with a heavily lined, paunchy face sits against a green and red wall in this vertical portrait painting. The man sits in a wooden chair painted forest green and rests both hands on the closer arm. His body and knees are angled to our left, and he turns his wide, square face to look at with heavy-lidded eyes. One brow seems slightly cocked, and he has a large nose. His lips are pulled up on one side over a round double chin. He wears a white, shoulder-length wig and a sable-brown suit. The cuffs of a white shirt are visible at his wrists where his hands are stacked on the arm of the chair. The knee-length breeches are buckled at the knee over black stockings. His legs are crossed away from us, and his feet extend off the bottom edge of the composition. The bottom half of the wall behind him is painted burgundy red up to and including a chair rail, and the wall above is moss green. The wall is lined with a gold scallop pattern along the top of the chair rail and a sliver of brown on across the bottom of the composition suggests a wood floor. The artist signed and dated the painting as if he had inscribed the red wall near the man’s knees, “John Singleton Copley pinx 1772. Boston.”

artworks.title: The Wife of Hasdrubal and Her Children
artworks.description: A woman holds the hands of two nude children in front of a crimson-red cloth in this vertical painting. All three have pale skin and brown hair. The woman wears a forest-green dress with voluminous sleeves and a gauzy white headdress that wraps around her hair and is fastened with a band across her forehead. She stands crouching with one foot extended slightly forward in a sandal, surrounded by broken chunks of masonry and bits of burning logs. Her body faces us but she turns her head to the right. Her mouth is wide open, and her eyes cut back to our left. The woman clutches the children’s hands in both of her own. The child to our left turns away from us and reaches one hand up to touch the back of the woman’s hand. The child on the right twists away from the woman, eyes squinted up and to the right and mouth open. Behind them, fold lines create a grid across the red cloth. Slivers of grass and blue sky line each side of the composition.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.description: This painting shows a man from the waist up. He is facing forward and gazes out at us. He has fair skin, light brown hair, a thin mustache and beard, and light green eyes. His expression is mostly neutral, although his peach lips are slightly turned up at the edges. He is wearing a black garment with a high collar and a hood and a black flat cap on his head. The background is plain blue, fading to black around the edges of the painting.

artworks.title: Peaceful Valley
artworks.description: The painting depicts a rural landscape at sunset or sunrise. The horizon is slightly above the center, showing distant pale-pink and purple mountains against the sky. Closest to us is an area with dark green bushes and vegetation, leading to a lighter green field surrounded by green-and-brown trees. The palette is warm and earthy, with greens and browns in the bottom transitioning to purples and pinks in the distance. The sky is a pale-yellow color that fades into light blue towards the top left corner, and faint yellow and gray clouds drift across it.

artworks.title: Daniel in the Lions' Den
artworks.description: A nearly nude, muscular man with pale, peachy skin sits in an underground cave among seven male and two female lions in this horizontal painting. The man sits to our right of center with his legs crossed, elbows close to his body with hands clasped by his chest. His head tips back to look up through a small opening above. He has long, wavy, chestnut-brown hair and dark eyes. A white cloth wraps across his hips, and he sits on a scarlet-red swath of fabric draped up over a rock next to him. The nine lions stalk, sit, or lie down around the man. One male lion next to the man, to our left, opens his mouth with his head thrown back, curling tongue extended beyond long fangs. A human skull and other bones are strewn on the dirt ground close to us. The rocky cave curves up around the animals and man to a narrow, round opening showing blue sky above.

artworks.title: El Rio de Luz (The River of Light)
artworks.description: We look through a tropical forest lining a hazy, wide, placid river in this horizontal landscape painting. Densely packed trees, bushes, and plants create shadowed, thickly forested banks along both sides of the river. The trees are covered with climbing vines, and they have gnarled, sprawling branches. Light catches the flat leaves of a palm-like plant close to us to our left, and once we take a closer look, we find two minuscule black birds with cherry-red chests perched on a long curving stem. The vegetation is reflected in the water’s surface into the distance, where it becomes pale mauve-pink and blends imperceptibly with the sky and clouds. A flock of white birds create a long line low over the water to our right. The sun is a small disk of white low in the humid sky amid pale lavender-purple clouds. The sun reflects in the calm surface of the water below, and it brings our attention to a person rowing a canoe, barely visible on the river in the deep, misty distance.

artworks.title: Mr. Pease
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The portrait shows the upper half of a man seated with his hands clasped in front. The man has a slightly stern expression with deep-set eyes and light, bushy eyebrows. He has short, white, neatly combed hair. He wears formal clothing including a black coat, buttoned vest, high-collared white shirt, and intricate cravat. The background is a dark, uniformly painted surface. A chair with a bit of red fabric is partially visible, adding contrast to the dark backdrop.

artworks.title: Mrs. Harlow A. Pease
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the waist up. She is facing forward with her hands resting on a book held upright. She has a composed expression with light skin, defined lips, and prominent cheekbones. Her hair is styled in a neat updo, and she wears a lace-trimmed bonnet. She is dressed in a dark, full-sleeved dress with a lace collar and a pin at the center. The background is a muted brown.

artworks.title: Ralph Wheelock's Farm
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: We look across a grassy field toward farm buildings spaced along a low rise, outlined against a blue sky in this long, horizontal landscape painting. Just over a dozen mounds, like green haystacks, create a row along the bottom edge of the composition. Several men wearing white shirts, black pants, and tall, black hats work with rakes nearby. One man, wearing a yellow hat, walks holding the hand of a child, who wears a red shirt. A dog trots alongside another man who carries a basket and a bottle. To our right, another man works next to a wagon loaded with the green harvest. Two brown oxen stand hitched to the wagon. The field stretches out in front of us. Four men work in neighboring rows, each holding a scythe, in the field to our left. At least a dozen buildings are lined up along the gently curving horizon, which comes a third of the way up the composition. There is a long, two-story, white house with a tan roof at the center. To either side are buildings in slate gray, mustard yellow, or brick red, sometimes spaced out and sometimes overlapping. A low rock wall runs up along the left edge of the painting, and two people ride horses in the lane on the far side. Tufts of trees are tucked in among the structures to our left, and a row of loosely spaced trees grows along the ridge to our right. White clouds line the horizon below a turquoise-blue sky. A band of nickel-gray clouds runs along the top edge of the painting.

artworks.title: Connecticut Sea Captain
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man standing with his body turned slightly to the right. He has light blue eyes and short brown hair with a side part. He is dressed in 19th-century formal clothing, including a navy blue coat, white shirt with a high collar, black neckcloth, and a gold waistcoat. He holds a red and gold cylindrical object in his right hand. The background displays a maritime scene with a red curtain partially drawn to reveal the sea and a sailing ship in the distance.

artworks.title: Connecticut Sea Captain's Wife
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a half-length portrait of a woman seated in a chair. She is facing slightly to her right, with her gaze directed towards the viewer. She has fair skin, blue eyes, and a solemn expression. Her hair is dark brown and styled in an elaborate updo with large, smooth rolls on either side of her head. She wears a black dress with voluminous sleeves and a high white ruffled collar. She has a brooch around her neck, gold earrings, and a ring with a green stone on her left hand, which is holding a book. The setting features a dark red curtain behind her, partially pulled back to reveal a countryside landscape through a window. A portion of the chair with a curved golden edge is also visible to her left.

artworks.title: James Cuthbert (?)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body. He is slightly angled to the right with his gaze directed to the left. The man has a composed expression with defined facial features, including a prominent nose and slightly uplifted lips. His hair is white and styled in a formal manner with curls on the sides. He is wearing a blue coat with large buttons, a white high-collared shirt, and a white cravat. One of his hands is tucked into the coat. The background is a muted, greenish hue.

artworks.title: Mary Cuthbert (Mrs. James Cuthbert) (?)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated from the waist up. She has her left hand raised to touch her face gently, while her right hand rests on a book in her lap. Her facial features are carefully painted with a fair complexion, rosy cheeks, and a thoughtful expression. She has light-colored eyes and hair, mostly covered by a white cap tied with a light blue ribbon under her chin. She wears a dress with a white collar and blue fabric, detailed with pleats and folds. A pearl necklace is around her neck. The background transitions from warm brown tones to an outdoor view with clouds and foliage.

artworks.title: Dr. David Rogers
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a seated man. He is positioned in an angled chair, facing slightly to his right. His facial features include a composed expression, a narrow nose, and focused eyes, with a prominent forehead framed by his powdered, shoulder-length hair. The man is dressed in a brown coat with large buttons over a pale waistcoat and a white, ruffled shirt. He holds a book in his left hand, resting it on the arm of the chair. The chair is upholstered in red fabric with a gold-studded trim. In the background, there is a bookcase filled with books, partially visible. The dark drapery provides contrast and depth to the setting.

artworks.title: Martha Tennent Rogers (Mrs. David Rogers) and Her Son, probably Samuel Henry Rogers
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch

artworks.title: Three Distinguished Warriors of the Sioux Tribe
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing side by side in full body view. They have long dark hair with feather decorations. They are dressed in traditional robes with fringes and patterns. Each holds specific objects: fur, quiver with arrows, and a feather fan. The background is plain with earth tones, emphasizing the individuals and their attire.

artworks.title: A Sioux Chief, His Daughter, and a Warrior
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three full-body figures standing in a row. The figure on the left has arms close to the body, wrapped in a garment with a bird and a fur collar. They have straight hair past their shoulders. The center figure wears a large feather headdress, a detailed cape with a sun-like emblem, and leggings matching the cape design. Their facial features are visible under the headdress. The figure on the right stands in profile, holding a spear and shield, wearing a garment with fringes, a headband with feathers, and a neutral background.

artworks.title: The Sioux Chief with Several Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows four adults and one child seated on the ground within an oval frame. The child is on the far left, lying down with a bow and arrow. Next to the child is a woman in a fringed garment with intricate designs, sitting cross-legged. To her right is a man with long hair, feathers, and facial markings, holding a pipe. Beside him is another woman in a similar garment. Seated on the far right is a fourth adult with long hair, feathers, and a beaded necklace, also holding a pipe. The background shows a soft, nondescript landscape in shades of blue and green.

artworks.title: A Little Sioux Village
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The painting shows a Plains encampment from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon line is high in the image, with a sky featuring soft clouds in light blue, pink, and white. In the center are teepees decorated with geometric patterns in beige, brown, and red. Figures, mostly indigenous people, are depicted around the camp. In the distance, a line of figures on horses moves diagonally to the right. The brushstrokes are detailed, emphasizing the teepees' patterns and the landscape's texture. The color palette is soft, with greens and light browns dominating.

artworks.title: Scalp Dance - Sioux
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This painting shows a group of people standing outside in a circle. They all have reddish-brown skin and long, dark hair decorated with red, white, and black feathers, and they wear a variety of garments. Some have tan pants with long fringe running down the sides, while others wear black and white feathers around their waists, hanging from colorful belts. Many of them have arms, legs, and chests decorated with red patterns like lines, swirls, dots, or handprints. They also wear lots of jewelry, including silvery bands on their arms and wrists, earrings in red and teal, and long strands of necklaces in similar colors. The people hold weapons including long bows, round shields, tall spears, and boomerang-shaped swords. Those around the edge of the circle appear to be dancing, their bodies bent over, knees bent, or arms outstretched. A group of people in the center of the circle hold up tall sticks with red ovals hanging from the top, black strands hanging from the ovals. The ground is light green, and the sky is light blue. The edges of the painting are plain, beige paper, within a green border.

artworks.title: Dog Dance - Sioux
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of individuals engaged in a dance. They are in a tightly-knit, curved line, with dynamic poses suggestive of movement and rhythm. The individuals have dark hair styled with feathers, and facial features include high cheekbones and strong profiles. They wear traditional attire, including skirts made from natural materials, and carry items like bows, arrows, and sticks. Some are seated on the ground, playing instruments like drums and rattles. The background is a gradient of sky-blue and sandy brown.

artworks.title: Ball-Play of the Women - Sioux
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a painting of a large gathering of individuals in an open landscape. The scene is set in an expansive grassy area bordered by hills under a blue sky with scattered clouds. The painting features numerous figures engaged in various activities. Some are seated, others are standing or involved in a dynamic assembly. The composition suggests motion and engagement, focusing on a central activity. This is in the style of George Catlin, known for his depictions of Native American life. The overall color palette is warm, with earthy tones dominating the foreground and cooler greens and blues framing the background.

artworks.title: A Dog Feast - Sioux
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard

artworks.title: Facsimile of a Sioux Robe with Porcupine Quills
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image has a symmetrical composition with a central rectangle surrounded by an irregularly shaped border. The artwork is abstract, using bold lines and geometric patterns resembling compass points, possibly depicting an ornate rug or ancient manuscript. The central area contains rows of red and tan lines, resembling text or scripts from a distant past. The colors are earthy tones and muted greens, enhancing the historical feel. A swirling design on the left side suggests motion or an abstract representation.
